_README: Free-quota overrides for ValleyMind's quota manager (core/quota_manager.py).
Nothing here is invented by the code: until YOU verify a provider's free
allowance against its dashboard, an overridable provider that could charge
money defaults to UNKNOWN and is BLOCKED (fail closed).
Set an entry under 'providers' only when you have confirmed, in the
provider's own dashboard, that the account still has free quota.
Alternatively set an env var: FREE_QUOTA_<PROVIDER>=available (and
state must be one of: available | exhausted | rate_limited | invalid_key | unknown
reset_at is optional epoch-seconds or ISO-8601; when reached, an exhausted
or rate-limited provider is re-evaluated against its default.
Valid provider keys: alibaba, fal, opencode, resend, openrouter, pinecone,

alibaba.note: Verified free trial tokens on 2026-10-01; re-check before it lapses.
